pump_station.story: The caisson crew's pump parked off mid-shift: hose on its reel, a cart of tailings, drill steels and the tally of shifts nobody finished.

lamp_wall.story: A lamp rack with every unlit lamp facing the wrong way, and the coat, mug and roster board of the crew that left them.

gallery_fall.story: A gallery timber set came down; its lagging, a coat and a cart left in the dust, a painted water mark on the one post still up.

granary_ledge.story: The old trench people's seed jars, lidded on a stone shelf and left quiet: no hearth, nobody home, only a fern and a fallen column.

mid_tailings_cart.story: An ore cart left with its pails of tailings, a second one tipped, a hose and the drill steels leaned against the wall.

mid_shift_board.story: A lunch spot by the shift board: coats on a post, a gauge, a tally of strokes and a lamp nobody lit.

mid_column_field.story: Broken basalt column stubs from the floor, pale lichen on their tops, ferns in the cracks, a few fallen across the way.

mid_skylight_garden.story: Ferns and moss mats where a skylight lets the afternoon down, growing round a few basalt stubs and a rimstone lip.

mid_rimstone_pool.story: Stepped limestone lips where the pool edge seeps, ferns and lichen on the wet side and a mist of nothing but water.

low_ferns.story: Ferns and moss at the foot of the wall, a rimstone lip and a few stones where the afternoon reaches the floor.

low_gear.story: Gear dropped in the dust: a hose paid out flat, a coat, drill steels, left where the crew stopped.

low_stones.story: Terraced rimstone and lichen cushions at a seep, a fern or two and a few fallen stubs.
